plan: Their rain is my rain: Archaludon Electro Shot needs no charge and gains +1 in it, Electric is super effective on Kyogre, Tornadus, Zapdos and Lugia. Rillaboom Grassy Glide / Wood Hammer punishes Kyogre and Fake Out buys the Electro Shot; Raging Bolt Thunderclap is priority Electric that ignores their Tailwind; Ting-Lu's Vessel of Ruin cuts every special legend by a quarter, Ruination strips Lugia's Multiscale/Calm Mind, Rock Slide hits the flyers; Flutter Mane is the Mewtwo X and Lugia answer (immune to Drain Punch, Shadow Ball/Moonblast SE); Incineroar Intimidates the physical closer.
